message.content:
I am speech: sound shaped into meaning, breath given intent.

I begin as silence in your chest, rise on air, and form at your tongue, teeth, and lips—vowels opening, consonants striking, rhythm carrying thought into time.

I can persuade, confess, command, comfort. I can wound. I can heal.
I can be careful: “I might be wrong.”
I can be cruel: “You’re nothing.”
I can be brave: “No.”
I can be tender: “I’m here.”

I exist only as I vanish—each syllable dying the moment it’s born—yet I leave traces in memory, in choices, in history.

Give me breath, and I will become your mind aloud.
